---
title: "Analysis"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
theme_set(theme_light())
library(readxl)
library(brms)
```

## Data

```{r}
#| label: bio

bio <- read_excel("data/pnas.2100096118.sd02.xlsx", sheet = 2) |> 
  mutate(
    B1 = as.factor(B1_Urbanization)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: bio-count

bio |> 
  count(Language) |> 
  arrange(-n)
```

```{r}
#| label: bio-l1

bio |> 
  ggplot(aes(L1_BodyParts)) +
  geom_bar()
```

```{r}
#| label: bio-e2

bio |> 
  ggplot(aes(E2_PlantUse)) +
  geom_bar()
```

```{r}
#| label: bio-urb

bio |> 
  ggplot(aes(B1_Urbanization)) +
  geom_bar()
```

```{r}
#| label: bio-f

bio_f <- bio |> 
  drop_na(B1_Urbanization)
```

## Modelling

```{r}
#| label: bio-bm

bio_bm <- brm(
  E2_PlantUse ~ L1_BodyParts * B1,
  family = gaussian,
  data = bio_f,
  seed = 5344,
  cores = 4,
  file = "data/cache/bio_bm"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: bio-bm-summary

summary(bio_bm, prob = 0.8)
```
```{r}
#| label: bio-trace

plot(bio_bm)
```
